title: Perry's Server Essentials
body:
This Mod adds 3 new features.

1. When you die you get a PRIVATE message of where your coordinates are.

2. after 15 minutes of being AFk, you get kicked, with a warning after 5 minutes.

3. When its nighttime and someone sleeps everyone gets to vote on if they should sleep. if more than half of the players agree then the nighttime is skipped.
